issues.detail: Threads TH2 (10 messages), TH3 (14 messages), TH4 (12 messages), and TH5 (13 messages) fall below the expected minimum of 15 messages per thread.
Artifact A7 is required in TH4 according to the blueprint, but it is never referenced in the thread's messages.
The forbidden term 'performance' is used in the text of messages M17 and M58. The forbidden term 'score' is used in messages M5 and M54.
Participants exhibit very similar and repetitive phrasing, particularly during the confirmation phases at the end of threads (e.g., multiple participants replying with 'Confirmed. I'll...').
